answer.reason: The "section of picture tiles" is most likely the Bento Section component (BentoSection), which shows a heading and a list of Bento cards and is described as a way to showcase screenshots or graphics. Its tiles are items in the BentoCards nested grid, which uses the BentoCard content model. BentoCard has Eyebrow, Title, Description, and a Graphic image field, which fits a tile with a large product screenshot. The alternative, the Images component (Gallery), uses GalleryImage, but that is a plain image grid with only an image and caption, with no title or description, so it doesn't match "tiles." I could not confirm on a live page that this section exists, because the search call timed out. Nothing was saved.
